label.en: Gross carrying amount of property, plant and equipment

currentTwLabel: 不動產、廠房及設備毛額
ifrsEnglish: Gross carrying amount of property, plant and equipment

zh-TW: 不動產、廠房及設備毛額

note.zh-TW: 模板沒有累計折舊列，把淨額當毛額用；網站內部保留累計折舊，兩者在折舊後會不同。
note.en: The template has no accumulated depreciation line and uses the net amount as the gross amount; the site keeps accumulated depreciation, so the two differ once depreciation is charged.

definition.zh-TW:
不動產、廠房及設備還沒扣掉累計折舊之前的原始成本總額。

毛額減累計折舊等於淨額；年報版的現金再投資比率分母用的是毛額。
definition.en:
The original cost of property, plant and equipment before deducting accumulated depreciation.

Gross amount less accumulated depreciation equals the net amount; the annual report version of the cash reinvestment ratio uses the gross figure in its denominator.

example.zh-TW: 位置：資產負債表不另列這個數字。課程模板沒有累計折舊列，所以模板裡的機器設備金額既當淨額也當毛額用；網站內部保留累計折舊，資產負債表的機器設備顯示淨額，毛額另外存放。折舊之前兩者相同，折舊之後開始不同。
example.en: Where it sits: not shown as a separate line on the balance sheet. The course template has no accumulated depreciation line, so its machinery figure serves as both net and gross; the site keeps accumulated depreciation internally, shows machinery net on the balance sheet and stores the gross amount separately. Before any depreciation the two are equal; afterwards they diverge.

misconception.zh-TW: 以為毛額就是設備現在值多少錢。毛額是歷史成本，和市價無關；它只是用來算折舊和某些比率的基準。
misconception.en: Taking the gross amount as what the equipment is worth today. It is historical cost, unrelated to market value, and serves only as the base for depreciation and certain ratios.

formula.zh-TW: 不動產廠房設備毛額 ＝ 取得成本合計 ＝ 淨額 ＋ 累計折舊。
formula.en: Gross property, plant and equipment = total cost = net amount + accumulated depreciation.
